da:kontor.why: what you stare at all day

da:ligge.why: what you do while doing it
where you do it in summer
the other side to rest on
where you stretch out in the park
what you do at the same time
you can do it without sleeping
how a thing waits in a drawer

da:land.why: what you show at the edge
what it is a piece of
the ground it is made of

da:sidde.why: a long one in the park
what it is a form of
you hunt for a free seat
you keep the same spot for hours
your name is on a card
a numbered seat in the dark

da:klar.why: what you do with an obvious thing
one with no doubt in it
standing at it with your coat

da:liv.why: what you do for one in danger
what you want out of it

da:hedde.why: what you do when you meet
what you do to find out
letter by letter for a stranger
one you do not know yet
what you do with a stranger's

da:international.why: the whole of it at once
many of them in one room

da:verden.why: the whole of it on paper
how it feels to a traveller
the roof over all of it

da:tale.why: two people doing it at once
how it carries across a room
who listens to a long one
an hour of people doing it
what a child does with it
what you do it in here

da:morgenmad.why: the first cup of the day
boiled at the start of the day
the first meal of the day
a buffet included in the price

da:næste.why: where it stands in a row
the button that moves you on

da:lade.why: who decide it for a child
you set one off the lead

da:gang.why: the one that begins the count
the one that ends the count
one of several in a row
the long room of the same name
which one of them it is
one on top of the rest
at the end of the hallway

da:ord.why: one that belongs to a person
what it is made of aloud
the puzzle of them in a grid

da:høre.why: nothing at all to take in
what you catch on the radio
what you catch on the radio
asked for when you missed it

da:fri.why: a seat with nobody in it
the kind you may say anything in

da:rejse.why: what you need at the border
what you do the night before
what you leave and return to

da:desværre.why: a shame it turned out so

da:spørge.why: raised in class to do it
what you do it about in a shop
who do it after a crime
who you do it to in a shop
who does it about your health

da:klasse.why: what you take home from it
the front seats are a better one

da:kort.why: only a few words in it
only a few letters in it

da:side.why: the two of them in a match
the other one to lie on

da:følge.why: you keep to what it says
how you do it on foot
how you do it in a chase
the one in front of you
